pr_title: Fix toast popups spamming samples when adjusting osu!mania scroll speed during gameplay
pr_body:
Not the most robust of fixes, but as per the reasoning described in the issue thread, a proper fix will take considerably more effort. This intends to fix the issue first and foremost, as it sounds so bad I'd want to mute my sound before adjusting currently.

Closes #15718.

issue_context.title: Tracked setting toast sound effect spammed when dragging scroll speed slider in settings overlay during gameplay
issue_context.body:
The sound is actually coming from the tracked setting toast, not the slider bar: https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/0641d5ddddd9919ee59f19a59b554387e5d586ad/osu.Game.Rulesets.Mania/Configuration/ManiaRulesetConfigManager.cs#L28-L37 The reason why the sample layers is that *every minuscule change* to the scroll speed setting causes a new `TrackedSettingToast` to be spawned, and every single one plays the same change sample with differing frequencies: https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/0641d5ddddd9919ee59f19a59b554387e5d586ad/osu.Game/Overlays/OnScreenDisplay.cs#L104 https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/0641d5ddddd9919ee59f19a59b554387e5d586ad/osu.Game/Overlays/OSD/TrackedSettingToast.cs#L91-L94 So there is not even a real good way to add a debounce without using static stuff. Not to mention that that whole structure of toasts is simple but madly inefficient and for it to be both clean & efficient you would probably have to rewrite half that system. ### Discussed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/discussions/15714
Originally posted by **TheEggo58** November 21, 2021 In the settings overlay when pausing gameplay & dragging an adjustment notch, the "notch-tick" sound is being played more than it should (or you could call it being "spammed". This only happens when the game is paused and only affects the "scroll speed" afaik, could be that this occurs in some other places too. Video explaining the issue in further detail here: https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/64386789/142757300-0813f564-eb83-4dfe-8ee7-8a29e86ca3bf.mp4

review_comments: Is it going to be an issue that `AddOnce` only keeps the earliest arg?
Maybe a very rare case. I think we should fix that framework side though (to always use the most recent) because it doesn't make sense as-is.
I pondered this myself but then decided that if two tracked settings are going to get changed in a single frame then there's really no good/sane thing to do anyhow.

I think this also applies to the same setting getting changed multiple times, ie via input events, which can potentially happen as a more likely scenario (where the last value is what we want):

https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/8672b3325a776726a8533d6b134aae83182ef5d3/osu.Game.Rulesets.Mania/Configuration/ManiaRulesetConfigManager.cs#L32
